news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60, part of a broader wave of post-earnings analyst target increases (H.C. Wainwright, Leerink, RBC, Mizuho also raised targets).

news.headline: Barclays Maintains uniQure (QURE) Rating, Lowers Price Target
news.summary: Barclays trimmed its QURE price target to $60 from $65 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's Q2 update on AMT-130's regulatory and data timeline.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: Q2 revenue of $5.8M beat estimates; uniQure confirmed via received FDA meeting minutes that 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, still targeted for Q3 2026, with 4-year data due in September and cash (~$810M) funding operations into 2030.

news.headline: uniQure stock upgraded by Wolfe Research on Huntington's therapy outlook
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded QURE from Peer Perform to Outperform ($65 target), saying the market underprices AMT-130's approval odds and modeling roughly 70% probability of success with ~$2B in U.S. peak sales.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Maintains uniQure (QURE) With Buy Rating, Raises Target Price to $80
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and lifted its QURE price target to $80 from $50, citing the improved regulatory picture for AMT-130 following the FDA's acceptance of the accelerated-approval pathway.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50, raising roughly $259 million in gross proceeds to fund AMT-130 commercialization prep, a confirmatory study, and pipeline advancement.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the accelerated approval pathway, using 3-year Phase I/II data as primary evidence, per FDA alignment reached in a June 2026 Type B meeting.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 4-year Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: Company plans to release 4-year follow-up data on 24 patients across the low- and high-dose cohorts, using an updated ~26,000-participant Enroll-HD comparator database.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 (epilepsy) second-cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Enrollment in the second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa study of AMT-260 for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy is expected to complete.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 2026 call that it expects and is preparing for an FDA Advisory Committee review of AMT-130 given it would be the first approved Huntington's therapy, though no meeting has been formally scheduled.

catalysts.label: Epilepsy and Fabry disease program clinical updates
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided to further clinical updates for AMT-260 (epilepsy) and AMT-191 (Fabry disease) in the first half of 2027.

pulse: uniQure's story is almost entirely about AMT-130 for Huntington's disease: after the FDA reversed course in June 2026, the agency now accepts 3-year Phase I/II data as the basis for an accelerated-approval BLA, which the company still plans to file in Q3 2026, with critical 4-year confirmatory data due in September and a possible Advisory Committee review ahead. A $259M equity raise closed in late June extended the cash runway into 2030 (~$810M on hand as of June 30), and sell-side sentiment turned sharply bullish after Q2 earnings, with Wells Fargo, Wolfe Research, H.C. Wainwright and others raising price targets even as Barclays trimmed its target slightly on execution/timeline risk.
